name: Hexagon-free graphs on 40 vertices with many edges
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..39 containing no six-cycle (exact search). Maximize the number of edges. A C6-free graph with m edges certifies ex(40;C6) >= m; the best known graphs have 105 edges and optimality is unproven.

science_relevance.importance_rationale: Erdős Problem #572 asks for ex(n;C_2k) >> n^(1+1/k); C6 is one of the few even cycles with known order of magnitude, and exact small values remain computationally open.
